products.name: V-72 Vector Drive
products.reputation: Efficient medium-freighter engine with excellent throttle response.
products.quirk: Mount alignment outside specification causes bearing wear far sooner than captains expect.

products.name: V-55
products.reputation: Older, less efficient drive with huge aftermarket support.
products.quirk: Many supposedly stock V-55s contain almost no original factory internals.

products.name: Rugged-6 Reactor
products.reputation: Heavy reactor famous for operating through poor maintenance and ugly load transients.
products.quirk: Mass penalty makes it unpopular on Ilyan-designed hulls.

products.name: Cascade 4 Closed-Cycle Plant
products.reputation: Mixed-species life-support package with configurable humidity zones.
products.quirk: Filter cartridges are compact but proprietary enough to annoy remote operators.

products.name: Coldwall 18
products.reputation: Modular heat exchanger bank whose individual cells can be isolated while underway.
products.quirk: External plumbing looks improvised even when installed exactly to specification.

products.name: Lifter-30 Cargo Arm
products.reputation: Slow but extremely tolerant of dust, ice and careless loading crews.
products.quirk: Hydraulic knock at low temperature is normal and has caused countless unnecessary maintenance calls.

products.name: Gearbox 7 Landing Set
products.reputation: Common landing assembly with parts available almost anywhere.
products.quirk: Frontier crews carry the same two bushings because those are what actually wear.
